aliases: Monoid (mu, eta) with associativity + unit laws

evidence.intree_statement: Class Monoid (X : C) : Type := { mu : X ⨂ X ~> X; eta : I ~> X; mu_assoc : mu ∘ bimap mu id[X] ≈ mu ∘ bimap id[X] mu ∘ to tensor_assoc; mu_unit_left : mu ∘ bimap eta id[X] ≈ to (@unit_left C M X); mu_unit_right : mu ∘ bimap id[X] eta ≈ to (@unit_right C M X) }

Class MonoidObject (mon : C) := { mempty : I ~> mon; mappend : mon ⨂ mon ~> mon; mempty_left : mappend ∘ bimap mempty id ≈ to (@unit_left C _ mon); mempty_right : mappend ∘ bimap id mempty ≈ to (@unit_right C _ mon); mappend_assoc : mappend ∘ bimap mappend id ≈ mappend ∘ bimap id mappend ∘ to tensor_assoc }

statement_record.book: A monoid c in a monoidal category <B,box,e> is an object c with mu: c box c -> c and eta: e -> c such that the associativity square (mu(1 box mu) = mu(mu box 1)alpha) and the two unit triangles (mu(eta box 1) = lambda, mu(1 box eta) = rho) commute.
statement_record.intree: Class Monoid / MonoidObject with fields mu/mappend, eta/mempty and laws mu_assoc/mappend_assoc, mu_unit_left/mempty_left, mu_unit_right/mempty_right, using to tensor_assoc, to unit_left, to unit_right.
statement_record.strength_comparison: same: two independent faithful renderings. Associativity uses the to-direction associator (X⨂X)⨂X -> X⨂(X⨂X) (MacLane orients alpha oppositely but notes it differs only by inverse; equivalent). Unit laws equate to the to-direction unitors, exactly MacLane. Setoid ≈ replaces = faithfully.

verifier.notes: Verified both citations at exact lines: Theory/Algebra/Monoid.v:44 (Class Monoid, fields mu/eta, laws mu_assoc/mu_unit_left/mu_unit_right) and Structure/Monoid.v:124 (Class MonoidObject, fields mappend/mempty). Two independent faithful renderings. PRESENT CONFIRMED.
